title: Petstock: 28% Cashback (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Petstock: 28% Cashback (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU

[camMMM] FYI don’t use auto ship as my order from last time didn’t track.
[Yunkitho] interesting. this stopped me doing it but keen to know what other people think
[camMMM] im just basing it on my own experience last time… whether you take the gamble is upto you.
[agentsmithy] I just used auto ship and it tracked if it helps anyone :)
[linkindan] $89.04 tracked off a $318 purchase in literally minutes - used $10 PetCash, never had issues tracking or paying out with it
[Jwhitey2035] Does it work with the after dark sale currently on?
[Minimee375] Ordered dog food, tracked in 5 minutes 👍
[Gmaster] Works with the concurrent After Dark sale. Tracked within 5 minutes.
[cooleagles] Spent ~$265 and got $77.50 back. Tracked in less than 5 mins
[Levathian] Is it really unlimited? Like I can purchase hundreds of $ worth of stuff?
[letters numbers] The only term relevant in OPs post would be (2) but it’s up to Petstock what constitutes “normal retail quantities”
[Garbotoxin] I made a first order and was tracked in 5 minutes. Made a second order (clicked through to PetStock again through the TCB link) but this time no tracking was recorded in 10 minutes….
Was there a limit of transaction count for this?
EDIT: nevermind, as I posted this, it tracked.
[Levathian] Woah $514 purchase $144 cashback hope they honour it 😬😱
One of my items had autoship as an option to save $50 but didn’t want to risk cashback not being paid…
[dinglejerry] Never had an issue before, they run these for petstock reasonably regularly.
[Flowerbomb] Wow with the 20% off dog food tonight, it’s such good value. Thanks OP.
[bboz] Tracked $38.05 on $135.90.
Simply Lovely, OP.
[rpb] Our Hill's Prescription Diet cat food still cheaper at PetCircle :(
[Jamesozbargain] Loaded up on puppy food until my dogs an adult. Thanks OP.

[nookie] Delivery to 3030 is not free?? My order is above %100
